chapters.title: 1. Supreme Court leaves Maryland's sensitive-places gun bans standing, as Justice Thomas signals doubts — Liberty versus order: when a right is fundamental, who decides where it ends, and can a right be hemmed in so tightly that it is effectively denied?

2. Supreme Court turns away Trump administration appeal over UC research grants cut for DEI — Who governs the university: does public funding give the state the right to shape what scholars pursue, or must the free pursuit of knowledge be shielded from whoever holds power?

3. Hundreds protest at Oxford as Nathan Cofnas speaks on DEI at Oriel College — Truth and tolerance: is the university a place where every claim may be heard and tested, or a community that must also protect the dignity of its members?

4. Pope Leo keeps Latin Mass limits and says married priests could divide the Church — Unity and diversity in the Church: is unity better kept by one common form or by generously making room for many legitimate traditions?
